title: Bramble – Local-first password manager
claim: Show HN: Bramble – Local-first password manager
why_good: A local-first password manager — timely as trust in cloud password managers wavers (post-breach anxiety).
value: Freemium/one-time + a paid sync/family/team tier; password managers have proven willingness to pay.
risk: Trust is everything here; unseating 1Password/Bitwarden needs a security track record most new entrants lack.

zh.claim: Show HN: Bramble —— 本地优先的密码管理器。
zh.why_good: 一个本地优先的密码管理器——在人们对云密码管理器信任动摇时(泄露后的焦虑),很及时。
zh.value: 免费增值/一次性 + 付费同步/家庭/团队档;密码管理器有被验证的付费意愿。
zh.risk: 这个品类里信任就是一切;要撼动 1Password/Bitwarden 需要新玩家大多没有的安全履历。
